note: POLARITY INVERTED with respect to match.json: a match here means the capability is PRESENT. It asks whether DXC computes and renders a clang FixItHint at all -- clause 1 anchors on the diagnostic actually firing (so a compile that never reached Sema cannot satisfy the predicate), clause 2 on the replacement source being printed under the caret. The replacement text appears nowhere in repro.hlsl, so clause 2 cannot be an echo of the input; note that this only holds while the repro is compiled without -Zi/-Qembed_debug, which would put the source into !dx.source.contents. Controls: `fixit-applied` (the corrected shader, which compiles clean) must score no-match, and `generic-fixit` (a missing-semicolon insertion hint, a fix-it for a different diagnostic) must also score no-match -- the second is what keeps the predicate from being read as `any fix-it anywhere`.
